The successful bidder shall supply the complete C-UAS Soft Kill System strictly in ac

cordance with the technical specifications, quantities and requirements stipulated in the bid. The scope sh all include two handheld electronic countermeasure systems, one vehicle mounted electronic countermea sure system and all associated batteries, chargers, antennas, carrying cases, telescopic sights and other a ccessories specified in the technical specifications. 2. Compliance with Technical Specifications. The offered equipment shall strictly conform to all para meters specified in the buyer's technical specifications, including product configuration, dimensions, weigh t, power requirements, environmental operating conditions, accessories and other stipulated features. Any deviation, omission or variation shall be treated as technical non-compliance unless specifically accepted by the Buyer through the prescribed process. 3. Technical Compliance Certificate. The bidder shall submit a duly signed and stamped technical com pliance statement against each parameter of the technical specifications, clearly indicating compliance, off ered make, model and relevant supporting document/page reference. General declarations without suppor ting technical literature shall not be considered sufficient. 4. OEM Technical Literature. The bidder shall submit original OEM datasheets, product brochures, tech nical catalogues and detailed specifications of the offered equipment with the bid. The documents must cle arly establish compliance with the prescribed technical requirements. Self-generated specifications withou t verifiable OEM supporting documents may not be accepted. 5. Make, Model and Country of Origin. The bidder shall clearly mention the make, model, manufacture r and country of origin of each offered system and its major components. The supplied equipment shall be brand new, unused, genuine and of current production and shall not be refurbished, reconditioned, second- hand or obsolete. 6. Complete Accessories. All accessories specified in the technical specifications shall be supplied along with the respective equipment. The handheld system shall include the specified batteries, 24V chargers, h ard carrying cases and telescopic sights. The vehicle-mounted system shall include the specified antennas and DC power/charging arrangement. No additional payment shall be admissible for accessories forming p art of the prescribed scope of supply. 7. Compatibility and Integration. All supplied components, accessories, batteries, chargers, antennas and power supply arrangements shall be fully compatible with the respective equipment. The bidder shall be responsible for resolving any compatibility issue arising during installation, testing or operation at no a dditional cost to the Buyer. 8. Quality Assurance. The equipment shall be manufactured and tested in accordance with applicable n ational/international quality standards and relevant statutory requirements. The bidder shall provide applic able quality certificates, test reports and conformity documents issued by the OEM or authorized testing a gency, wherever applicable. 9. Inspection and Acceptance. The equipment shall be subject to physical inspection, verification of sp ecifications, quantity, accessories, make/model and functional demonstration by the Board/Technical Inspe ction Committee nominated by the Buyer. Final acceptance shall be subject to satisfactory inspection and successful demonstration of the contracted requirements. Mere delivery of equipment shall not constitute acceptance. 10. Functional Demonstration. The successful bidder/OEM shall arrange a comprehensive demonstrati on of the supplied systems at the consignee's location. The demonstration shall establish the functionality of the equipment, power arrangements, battery backup, accessories, operating controls and other contrac ted features. Any deficiency observed shall be rectified by the bidder at its own cost. 11. Delivery and Installation. The bidder shall ensure safe transportation, delivery, installation and com missioning, wherever applicable, at the consignee's designated location within the stipulated delivery perio d. All expenses towards packing, forwarding, freight, insurance, installation and commissioning shall be de emed included in the quoted price, wherever applicable under the bid. 12. Training. The successful bidder/OEM shall provide necessary operational and maintenance training to the nominated personnel of the user unit. The training shall cover equipment handling, operating procedur es, safety precautions, battery maintenance, routine troubleshooting and preventive maintenance. Trainin g shall be provided without any additional financial implication to the Buyer. 13. Warranty. The complete equipment, including all supplied accessories, batteries, chargers, antennas, power supply units and other components, shall carry a comprehensive warranty of minimum two years fr om the date of successful installation, commissioning and acceptance, or as specified in the GeM bid, whic hever is applicable. The warranty shall cover manufacturing defects, component failures, malfunctioning, b

attery/charger defects, hardware faults, replacement of defective parts, repair and all associated labour an d transportation costs. 14. Warranty Support. During the warranty period, the bidder shall attend to all reported defects within 48 hours of notification and ensure rectification within a reasonable timeframe mutually agreed with the B uyer. In case of failure to rectify the defect within the stipulated period, the Buyer shall be entitled to take appropriate contractual action as per GeM terms and applicable rules. 15. Replacement of Defective Equipment. Any equipment or component found defective, damaged, malfunctioning or not conforming to the stipulated specifications during inspection or warranty shall be re paired or replaced by the successful bidder free of cost. Repeated failure of the same equipment shall req uire complete replacement with a new unit, subject to applicable contractual provisions. 16. Battery Performance. All batteries supplied shall be brand new, genuine and compatible with the re spective systems. The batteries shall conform to the specified voltage and capacity requirements. The bidd er shall provide the OEM battery specifications and applicable safety documentation. Any battery failing to deliver the specified performance under normal operating conditions shall be replaced during the warranty period. 17. User Manuals and Documentation. The bidder shall provide comprehensive OEM operation manual s, maintenance manuals, technical literature, troubleshooting instructions, warranty certificates and equip ment-specific documentation along with the supply. All documents shall be provided. 18. After-Sales Service. The bidder/OEM shall ensure adequate after-sales support, availability of traine d technical personnel and availability of genuine spare parts during the warranty and subsequent support period, as applicable. The bidder shall provide contact details of the authorized service centre and designa ted technical support representative. 19. Confidentiality and Information Security. All information, documents, technical details and operat ional information provided by the Buyer or accessed during execution of the contract shall be treated as st rictly confidential. The bidder and its representatives shall not disclose, reproduce, transfer or use such inf ormation certificate for any purpose other than execution of the contract without prior written approval of the competent authority. 20. Statutory and Regulatory Compliance. The bidder shall be solely responsible for obtaining all appl icable licences, approvals, permissions, clearances and statutory authorizations required for the manufact ure, import, supply, installation, demonstration and operation of the offered equipment, wherever applicab le. In particular, all applicable regulatory requirements relating to radio-frequency transmission, spectrum usage and electromagnetic emissions shall be complied with. No equipment shall be operated during dem onstration or testing without the requisite permissions from the competent authority. 21. No Unauthorized Modification. The successful bidder shall not make any unauthorized modification , substitution or alteration in the supplied equipment, software, hardware, firmware or accessories without prior written approval of the Buyer. 22. Price Inclusiveness. The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable costs towards equipment, a ccessories, packing, forwarding, transportation, insurance, installation, commissioning, demonstration, trai ning, documentation and warranty obligations as stipulated in the bid. No additional financial claim shall b e entertained for items and services forming part of the contracted scope. 23. Liquidated Damages. In case of delay in delivery, installation or commissioning attributable to the s uccessful bidder, liquidated damages shall be applicable as per the relevant GeM General Terms and Cond itions and contractual provisions. Liquidated damages certificate shall be submitted at the time of TEC. 24. Risk and Cost. In case of failure by the successful bidder to fulfil contractual obligations, supply conf orming equipment or rectify deficiencies within the stipulated period, the Buyer shall be entitled to take ap propriate action, including cancellation of the contract, risk purchase and other remedies available under a pplicable GeM terms and Government procurement rules. 25. Right of Rejection. The Buyer reserves the right to reject any equipment, component or accessory t hat does not conform to the stipulated technical specifications, is found defective, is incomplete or fails to meet the prescribed inspection and acceptance requirements. Such rejection shall be without prejudice to other contractual remedies available to the Buyer. 26. No Substitution Without Approval. The successful bidder shall supply only the make and model qu oted and accepted during the procurement process. Any change in make, model, manufacturer or configur ation shall require prior written approval of the competent authority. Supply of an alternative or inferior pr

oduct without approval shall constitute a contractual violation. 27. Integrity and Authenticity of Documents. All documents, certificates, declarations and technical i nformation submitted by the bidder shall be genuine, valid and verifiable. Submission of forged, misleadin g, false or materially incorrect information may result in rejection of the bid, cancellation of contract and ot her action as permissible under applicable procurement rules. 28. Acceptance of ATC. Submission of the bid shall be deemed to constitute acceptance of the applicabl e Additional Terms and Conditions. The successful bidder shall comply with all contractual obligations, tech nical requirements and statutory provisions throughout the execution of the contract. . 27.
